items.headline: Goldman Sachs upgrades Indian equities to "Overweight," Nifty 50 target at 28,500 by Dec 2027
items.summary: Goldman Sachs cites an expected earnings growth of 15% in calendar years 2027 and 2028, resilient domestic demand, and renewed foreign investment. They project the Nifty 50 to reach 28,500 by December 2027, with real GDP growth moderating slightly to 7.2% in 2027 from 7.9% in 2026.

items.headline: India's weight in MSCI Emerging Markets index rises, further increases expected
items.summary: Axis Capital noted a rise in India's weight in the MSCI Emerging Markets index by 400 basis points since October 1st, reaching 14.7%, with further increases expected in the coming weeks.

items.headline: Indian markets poised for a gap-up opening despite mixed global cues
items.summary: GIFT Nifty futures indicate a positive start for Indian equities, contrasting with lower Asian markets that mirrored Wall Street's weakness due to a sell-off in US technology shares like Nvidia. Crude oil prices have recovered, and the Indian Rupee remains stable.

items.headline: Q2FY27 earnings season resilient with strong growth, Nomura reports
items.summary: Nomura's review of 264 companies in the BSE 200+ universe for Q2FY27 revealed a 31% year-on-year earnings growth, surpassing Bloomberg consensus estimates by 14%, though core margins hit a four-year low. The oil and gas sector was a significant contributor to the overall earnings beat.

items.headline: Several companies to announce Q2FY27 results today, November 25, 2026
items.summary: Anya Polytech & Fertilizers, Simbhaoli Sugars, Ajwa Projects, Siemens Energy India (audited results and final dividend), RBM Infracon, and Pulsar International are scheduled to announce their quarterly and half-yearly results today.

items.headline: IT and realty sectors see buying interest; banking and metal face selling pressure
items.summary: On Monday, the IT and realty sectors experienced buying interest in the market. Conversely, banking and metal sectors faced selling pressure during the same period.

items.headline: Goldman Sachs overweight on banks, industrials, defense; underweight on IT, healthcare
items.summary: Goldman Sachs holds an "Overweight" stance on banks, industrials, defense, utilities, telecom, and the internet sectors. They maintain an "Underweight" position on information technology, healthcare, metals, cement, and chemicals.

items.headline: Arvind expands manufacturing capabilities; Sterling and Wilson secure new energy projects
items.summary: Arvind is enhancing its manufacturing capabilities by integrating 3D weaving technology. Separately, Sterling and Wilson have successfully secured three new renewable energy projects.

items.headline: 3B BlackBio Dx to acquire Epistem Limited; Tata Steel undergoes business restructuring
items.summary: 3B BlackBio Dx is set to acquire UK-based Epistem Limited for £723,000. Additionally, Tata Steel plans to maintain its EBITDA per tonne through the acquisition of downstream assets from APL Apollo, an announcement that led to APL Apollo Tubes shares falling 22% and Tata Steel slumping 10%.

items.headline: Adani Energy Solutions subsidiary secures 1,750 MW renewable energy order
items.summary: Adani Energy Solutions (AESL) subsidiary, Powerpulse Trading Solutions Ltd., has secured an order from West Bengal State Electricity Distribution Co. Ltd. to supply 1,750 MW of round-the-clock renewable energy for a period of 25 years.

items.headline: Tata Motors PV and Hyundai Motor India to raise vehicle prices
items.summary: Both Tata Motors PV and Hyundai Motor India are planning to increase their vehicle prices. This move is aimed at offsetting the rising input costs they are currently facing.
